info.title: EMASS Toolkit API
info.description: EMASS Toolkit backend API. All responses use the envelope `{ success, statusCode, message, data? }`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Policy-routed signups, set-password invites, MFA for staff, rotating refresh tokens

get.summary: Issue an image captcha (cookie carries the expected answer)

post.summary: Sign up (no password) — competitor domains blocked, free-mail queued for approval, custom domains get a set-password email

201.description: Account created — pending approval or set-password email sent

post.summary: Sign in — customers get tokens; DEV/ADMIN get { mfaRequired: true } and an emailed OTP

200.description: Logged in, or MFA challenge issued

post.summary: Resend an MFA login OTP (DEV/ADMIN) or a password-reset OTP
Verify an MFA login OTP (issues tokens) or validate a reset OTP

get.summary: Look up a set-password invite (email + expiry) for the UI

post.summary: Redeem a set-password token (activates the account)
Request a fresh set-password email (PENDING_SET_PASSWORD only)
Reset the password with a reset OTP (revokes all sessions)
Rotate the refresh-token cookie and issue a new access token (cookie only; one call in flight per device)

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or reused refresh token

post.summary: Revoke the refresh-token cookie and clear it

get.summary: List PENDING_APPROVAL signups oldest first, cursor-paginated, with name/email search (ADMIN only)

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque; pass the previous response's nextCursor

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive; every word must match a name part or the email

post.summary: Approve a signup — sends the set-password email
Reject a signup — blocks the account and emails the person (optional reason included)
